related.title: 德基水力發電系統
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作；德基水力發電系統改以薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping; Techi Hydropower System centers on thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Coulee流量水頭與德基有效水頭，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到德基水力發電系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以生態與泥砂指標為起點，設計一項能區分「多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作」與「薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare coulee flow/head with techi effective head and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Techi Hydropower System, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.
Start from ecology/sediment metrics and propose an observation distinguishing multiple units, reservoir, irrigation and pumping from thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy, including uncertainty.

related.title: 胡佛水壩水力發電系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「班克斯湖抽水與灌溉」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；胡佛水壩水力發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Pumping to Banks Lake for irrigation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦重力壩、805 MW 級機組與灌溉抽水的多目標運轉；胡佛水壩水力發電系統則以1930 年代拱形重力壩的分塊澆置、管冷溫控與百年機組更新為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on multi-purpose operation of a gravity dam, 805 MW-class units and irrigation pumping; Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System centres on block placement and pipe cooling of a 1930s arch-gravity dam and a century of unit renewal, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「比速與水輪機型式」的模型移到胡佛水壩水力發電系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「洩洪隧道空蝕與摻氣槽」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Specific speed and turbine type" to Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Spillway-tunnel cavitation and aerators", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「班克斯湖抽水與灌溉」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；胡佛水壩水力發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Pumping to Banks Lake for irrigation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System must be respecified.

related.title: 羅伯特布拉薩水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「班克斯湖抽水與灌溉」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；羅伯特布拉薩水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Pumping to Banks Lake for irrigation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Robert-Bourassa Generating Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦重力壩、805 MW 級機組與灌溉抽水的多目標運轉；羅伯特布拉薩水電站則以世界最大地下電廠之一、階梯式溢洪道與 735 kV 長距離輸電為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on multi-purpose operation of a gravity dam, 805 MW-class units and irrigation pumping; Robert-Bourassa Generating Station centres on one of the world's largest underground stations, a stepped spillway and long-distance 735 kV transmission, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「比速與水輪機型式」的模型移到羅伯特布拉薩水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「巨人階梯溢洪道」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Specific speed and turbine type" to Robert-Bourassa Generating Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The giant's staircase spillway", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「班克斯湖抽水與灌溉」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；羅伯特布拉薩水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Pumping to Banks Lake for irrigation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Robert-Bourassa Generating Station must be respecified.

history.title: 大古力水電站
history.text: 大古力水電站的公開資料展示多機組、水庫、灌溉與抽水協作的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
